semiconductor_relevance: High — Hansol Iones specializes in precision components for the semiconductor and display industries, providing a comprehensive range of services from design to processing.
summary: Hansol Iones is a leading provider of ultra-precision components for the semiconductor and display sectors, offering a one-stop solution that includes design, processing, measurement, cleaning, coating, and analysis. Established in 1993, the company has continuously evolved through technological advancements and customer satisfaction, positioning itself as a key player in the semiconductor supply chain.
capabilities: Precision component processing for semiconductor applications
Cleaning and coating solutions specifically for semiconductor manufacturing
Development of new materials and nano-coating technologies

regional_presence.Korea: Hansol Iones is headquartered in Korea and has established a dedicated factory for semiconductor cleaning and coating.
